ios.desc:
VoicePing gives you a Walkie Talkie App for the long-range walkie-talkie. You can walkie-talkie in a group or with an individual no matter how far they are from you as long as you are connected to the Internet. Enjoy texting, picture and video messaging unified in one app. 

VOICEPING FEATURES: 
• Texting, picture, and video messaging unified on one screen
• Communicate in Groups and Private channels to get work done faster 
• Page or send SOS so you can get help quickly. You’ll be automatically switched to the channel that receives the SOS. 
• Desktop Version available for more seamless communication between in-office and field workers
• Thousands of Public Channels: Choose from 9999 public channels. Unlimited people can join

VOICEPING ENTERPRISE FEATURES: 
• Unlimited Private Channels. All channels are private. All users are controlled via administrative tools.
• Enterprise Directory: Easy to find colleagues and add as contacts
• Private Domain: We do not allow anybody to join your walkie-talkie channel other than your co-workers 
• Admin Portal: Allows the administrator to Add, Manage & Remove users. 
• Web Desktop: Give your telephone operator, dispatchers, or managers in the office the ability to send text and walkie-talkie via the desktop web.
• Location Tracking: You can see where everyone is with location maps (GPS) both on mobile iOS and web desktop. 
• Recordings: Download all messages within a specified time from the Server via the Admin Dashboard. (Read) 
• API: Access Access to our API if you need to integrate with your systems.
• Support: We provide technical support via phone & email during Business Days/Hours. 
• SLA: We provide a 99.95% Service Level Agreement to ensure no downtime for your business. (Read)

quotes.text:
Can I make my laptop to be a walkie talkie?
Can I make my phone to be a walkie talkie?
Yes, you can do that! Without paying anything.
Go to https://web.voiceoverping.net if you don't believe. 
Or download on your android phone: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.media2359.voiceping.store
Or download on your iOS phone: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/voiceping/id1249953303?ls=1&mt=8

Type 4 digits channel ID you want to join. Click Join Channel.
On the other devices do the same. Now tada talk as long as you want!
